title: Quasar runtime-compatibility boundary map
description: Schema for config/quasar/runtime-compatibility.json — the per-file static compatibility boundary for Quasar demo mode. scripts/check-quasar-runtime-compatibility.mjs compiles this schema and validates the document against it before any status, filesystem, or submission-readiness check, and refuses if the schema itself cannot be read or compiled, so these constraints are enforced rather than advisory. The same file is also the Quasar lane's fingerprint selector: scripts/lib/surfpool-evidence-manifest.mjs reads it under a descriptor-bound contract and folds the paths it lists into the lane source fingerprint. This schema constrains only what is decidable from the document text; the selector remains the authoritative check for everything that depends on filesystem state.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path, already normalized. The pattern rejects everything the fingerprint selector can refuse on text alone: an empty value, a leading slash, a Windows drive prefix or any backslash (so UNC forms are excluded too), an empty segment from a doubled or trailing slash, and any '.' or '..' segment. It deliberately stops there — JSON Schema cannot observe the filesystem, so scripts/check-quasar-runtime-compatibility.mjs (existence) and the fingerprint selector in scripts/lib/surfpool-evidence-manifest.mjs (repository containment, ordinary file or directory, no symbolic-link traversal) stay the authoritative checks for everything that depends on filesystem state. A path that satisfies this pattern can still be refused there; nothing is normalized on the selector's behalf.

surface.description: The runtime surface this path belongs to. Required to carry at least one non-whitespace character: an audited demo-critical path with a blank surface records no boundary at all, and this schema is the enforcing check for that — scripts/check-quasar-runtime-compatibility.mjs refuses the document here before any status or filesystem check.

status.description: Compatibility status, additionally required to appear in allowedStatuses by scripts/check-quasar-runtime-compatibility.mjs. The non-whitespace constraint is enforced here so a blank status cannot be admitted by a document that also lists a blank value in allowedStatuses.

reason.description: Why the path carries its status. Required to carry at least one non-whitespace character so an audited entry cannot pass the gate with no recorded justification.
